messages:
vuln-bot: NEW CVE detected: CVE-2026-4512 affecting npm package `jsonwebtoken` <= 8.1.2. Description: algorithm confusion allows bypass of signature verification in certain HS/RSA switch cases. Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-4512 :eyes:

maria: grabbing initial signal. CVSSv3: 7.8 (High) reported on NVD. EPSS: 0.72. Exploit maturity unknown. Marking for immediate triage.

raj: quick check — our monorepo uses `jsonwebtoken` in `auth-service` and `session-proxy`. Running `npm ls jsonwebtoken` now.

raj: output:
```
auth-service@1.4.0 -> jsonwebtoken@8.1.1 (direct)
session-proxy@2.0.3 -> tslib -> jsonwebtoken@8.1.1 (transitive)
```

alyssa: infra note — prod auth-service is pinned to 1.4.0 on Dedicated. session-proxy sits on edge fleet (managed). Both sound impacted.

karim: is there an exploit PoC in the wild? Anyone see a public repo?

maria: small PoC posted as gist yesterday, not weaponized yet but demonstrates HS->RS alg confusion when `alg` header is tampered. Link: https://github.com/claimer/poc-jwt-algo-bypass (marked as unverified).

tim: threat ops — if PoC exists, treat as priority. What's our blast radius? user tokens, session cookies, internal service-to-service JWTs?

raj: blast radius: user session tokens (long-lived), internal service-to-service tokens used for metadata calls. auth-service issues both. session-proxy validates user cookies at edge.

maria: recommendation: P1. Immediate mitigations: 1) temporarily reject tokens signed with HS algorithms at edge; 2) short-term rotate signing keys for internal service tokens; 3) WAF rule to block JWTs with `alg` header mismatch patterns.

alyssa: can add WAF rule in front of session-proxy today. Example match: `Authorization: /^Bearer .*\"alg\":\s*(\"HS|hs\")[^}]*\"kid\":/` — will craft exact rule. ETA 3 hours.

karim: RBAC/ops question — do we need any KMS key rotations? Our signing uses KMS RSA keys for service tokens, and a HS secret stored in Vault for user sessions. If we rotate KMS keys, that won't fix HS tokens. We should rotate the Vault secret and backfill short TTL.

maria: agree. Plan: rotate Vault HS secret for sessions ASAP, issue short-lived replacement tokens (30m) and force refresh on next auth. For KMS-backed RSA keys, schedule rotation but lower urgency.

tim: creating ticket now: SEC-2026-178 JWT algo bypass. Assigning owners: auth-service patch -> raj, session-proxy WAF -> alyssa, secrets rotation -> karim.

maria: patch plan: bump `jsonwebtoken` to 9.x where fixed, run compatibility tests; if major bump incompatible, apply a targeted fix: strict algorithm enforcement during verify call (reject tokens with alg != expected). Backport to 1.4.x and 2.0.x branches.

raj: ETA for auth-service patch (dev + CI): 6h. Backport PRs: 12-24h. Hotfix release to Dedicated: 4-6h after PR merge.

alyssa: WAF rule deployed to canary fleet in 1h, full rollout 3h after testing.

karim: rotating Vault secret now. Will publish rotated secret and update auth-service CI to pull new secret. Rolling secret rotation to prod in 2h, force session invalidation in 3h.

maria: telemetry/action items: enable audit logging for token verify failures in auth-service and session-proxy, add alert if token verify failures spike > 5/min for > 2m. Also add a filter to our log retention for `alg` tampering indicators.

tim: covered — adding alerts to SEC-SIG.

raj: quick commands for teams: `npm audit fix` won't help; do `npm install jsonwebtoken@9.0.0` and ensure verify() call uses `algorithms: ['RS256']` or expected set.

maria: final severity: High / P1. Public PoC -> treat as exploitable; EPSS 0.72 supports rapid prioritization. Creating exec summary for incident channel after we validate mitigations. :thumbsup:

karim: noted. I'll post a short status update in #incidents once WAF + secret rotation done.

alyssa: progress update: canary WAF rule deployed — blocked 3 suspicious JWTs with `alg` mismatch.

maria: great. keep me posted. If we see internal service failures, we may need a rollback plan for the WAF rule.

vuln-bot: SEC-2026-178 created: https://redwood.internal/SEC-2026-178 — assigned to raj, alyssa, karim.

maria: thanks everyone. follow-ups: 1) confirm auth-service patch merged and deployed; 2) confirm Vault secret rotated + sessions invalidated; 3) confirm alerts firing and telemetry captures PoC attempts. We'll post post-mortem template in the ticket.

tim: oncall will monitor overnight, escalate if any evidence of successful bypass. :alarm_clock:
